purpose: Track Agalmic Research investigations from prior-art screening through analysis to publication, narrowing, handoff or retirement so serious research does not disappear into an idle queue.

records.title: Epistemic Handoff: prior-art boundary and narrowed protocol
records.question: Is epistemic handoff a distinct institution, and if not, what narrower contribution survives established knowledge-transfer and expert-routing literatures?
records.prior_art_outcome: Generic knowledge handoff, brokerage, absorptive capacity, innovation intermediation and expertise routing are established antecedents.
records.adversarial_outcome: The broad novelty claim failed. A narrower claim-sensitive, provenance-preserving protocol may remain useful if it explicitly represents the authority deficit and requested epistemic function.
records.design: Deep prior-art review and adversarial novelty narrowing.
source_data: Published literature on absorptive capacity, knowledge transfer, knowledge brokerage, innovation intermediaries, transactive memory and expert evaluation
records.result_summary: Generic epistemic handoff is not claimed as novel. The surviving research object is a narrower operational protocol and its empirical test.

scarcity_transition.abundance_used: machine-assisted literature search and open scholarly sources
scarcity_transition.next_scarcity: empirical validation of the narrowed mechanism
scarcity_transition.residual_human_role: interpret contribution boundaries and accept responsibility for claims

records.disposition: research note + narrowed draft; broad novelty retired

records.title: Economics of epistemic abundance: formal-boundary null test
records.question: Does the proposed economics of epistemic abundance currently require a distinct Agalmic economic primitive beyond established complementarity, bottleneck, production and innovation theory?
records.prior_art_outcome: Mature economic antecedents already explain the generic movement of binding constraints when one input becomes cheaper.
records.adversarial_outcome: The proposed distinct law/primitive did not survive the formal-boundary null test in its current form.
records.design: Formal and conceptual null test against established economic explanations.
source_data: Production economics, complementarity, bottleneck, innovation, production-network and rebound-effect literatures
records.result_summary: No distinct economic primitive is presently claimed. A narrower empirical programme remains: measure how constraints, shadow values and rents move after large capability-cost shocks.

scarcity_transition.initial_scarcity: formal economic expertise and prior-art comparison
scarcity_transition.abundance_used: machine-assisted formal comparison and literature synthesis
scarcity_transition.next_scarcity: credible empirical identification across real scarcity-transition cases
scarcity_transition.residual_human_role: judge economic interpretation and limits of the null test

records.disposition: null result; empirical measurement question preserved as an option

records.title: Expert-Attention Handoff Triage: retrospective scarcity benchmark
records.question: Can pre-expert triage increase useful evaluation yield under constrained review capacity without unacceptable false negatives, status bias or presentation sensitivity?
records.prior_art_outcome: Generic pre-filtering, AI idea screening, editorial triage, selective prediction, learning to defer, active learning and value-of-information are established. The possible contribution is a claim-sensitive allocation benchmark and test.
records.adversarial_outcome: The special mechanism should be retired if simple rules or conventional model triage achieve equivalent recall/yield at lower complexity.
records.design: Retrospective computational experiment over historical peer-review data with simulated review budgets, blinded pre-review features, multiple imperfect outcomes and reject auditing.
source_data: Public OpenReview records for replication where visibility permits
OpenAlex downstream scholarly metadata only if justified after feasibility
records.result_summary: Phase 1 showed that ranking by historical review score can preserve accepted papers while sharply reducing preservation of high-disagreement cases. The broader allocation problem is now carried by Attention Allocation Under Cognitive Abundance rather than a parallel triage programme.

cost.paid_data_or_software: planned open-data first; no paid source currently required
cost.external_expert_time: zero in retrospective phase; prospective experts only if residual validation becomes high-value

scarcity_transition.abundance_used: historical expert judgments, open peer-review data and machine computation
scarcity_transition.next_scarcity: data quality and validity of retrospective proxies
scarcity_transition.residual_human_role: define valid constructs, inspect failure modes and decide whether prospective expert validation is warranted

records.disposition: phase-1 result preserved; empirical lineage absorbed into Attention Allocation Under Cognitive Abundance

records.title: Attention Allocation Track A v0.1: pre-outcome feasibility test
records.question: Can a transparent allocation-policy comparison over historical ICLR candidates reach the preregistered five-percentage-point precision target without temporal leakage, selection-observability failure or lineage contamination?
records.prior_art_outcome: The mechanism is grounded in active learning, selective labels, constrained ranking, exploration/exploitation and bibliographic record-linkage rather than treated as a novel allocation field.
records.adversarial_outcome: The study passed technical availability and lineage gates, but 0/5 primary policy contrasts were prospectively precise enough for the frozen five-percentage-point smallest effect. Citation outcomes therefore remained sealed.
records.design: Outcome-blind historical reconstruction, deterministic representation and policy selection, exact identity observability audit, lineage audit and a fail-closed pre-outcome precision adjudicator.
source_data: OpenAlex identity metadata without citation outcomes
records.result_summary: ABSTAIN_PRE_OUTCOME at N=1,815. The system refused to query the preregistered C5 citation outcome because prospective 95% half-widths were approximately 7.7–7.9 percentage points rather than <=5 points.

cost.machine_compute_or_api: bounded open-data and low-cost metadata acquisition

scarcity_transition.abundance_used: public archival data, machine extraction and deterministic analysis
scarcity_transition.next_scarcity: prospective sample size / neutral historical state
scarcity_transition.residual_human_role: freeze constructs and accept an ABSTAIN result before outcomes are opened

records.disposition: negative feasibility result; successor must be prospectively larger rather than weakening v0.1 gates

records.title: Attention Allocation Track A v0.2: multi-cohort source feasibility
records.question: Can enough selection-neutral historical candidate state be reconstructed across ICLR cohorts to support at least 4,600 exact-outcome-observable candidates before downstream outcomes are opened?
records.prior_art_outcome: Historical-version reconstruction and bibliographic observability are treated as measurement problems rather than assumed properties of current public records.
records.adversarial_outcome: Verified/pre-review 2018–2020 sources plus an optimistic perfect 2017 upper bound yield only 4,502 candidates before identity attrition. The convenient ICLR 2021 reviewed-version field is perfectly historical-decision-linked and is disqualified.
records.design: Metadata-only multi-cohort source audit with pinned historical snapshots, temporal provenance checks and a source-feasibility stop before bulk content or citation acquisition.
source_data: Pinned ICLR 2018 and 2019 pre-review Git snapshots
records.result_summary: SOURCE_FEASIBILITY_INADEQUATE_NEUTRAL_COHORT_REQUIRED. Bulk historical-text acquisition remains off until a neutral additional cohort is recovered.

scarcity_transition.abundance_used: multi-year public metadata and historical snapshots
scarcity_transition.residual_human_role: decide source admissibility and preserve temporal/selection boundaries

records.disposition: continue source recovery only; no bulk PDF or citation acquisition while gate is closed
records.next_action: Recover a neutral ICLR 2021 deadline/pre-review state or preregister an additional comparable cohort, then rerun source and precision gates.

records.title: Cognitive Kernel consequence pilot
records.question: Does the Agalmic Cognitive Kernel reduce active human attention or downstream rework on real tasks without degrading verified completion or authority boundaries?
records.prior_art_outcome: Matched experiments, counterbalancing, productivity measurement and human-AI collaboration evaluation are established. The local value is the outcome/attention instrumentation and explicit isolation contract.
records.adversarial_outcome: Prompt-level conformance is not evidence of capability. The intervention should be weakened or retired if it merely shifts effort into validation, increases rework, or violates boundaries.
records.design: Prospective 12-pair pilot across four task families and at least two generator families, with isolated control/kernel conditions and sealed execution receipts.
source_data: Real research, repository, analysis and publication tasks with task-appropriate verification
records.result_summary: Protocol and execution evidence are frozen; no efficacy result has yet been earned.

cost.human_curator_time: primary outcome to be measured prospectively

scarcity_transition.abundance_used: structured machine cognition and sealed experimental execution
scarcity_transition.residual_human_role: perform accountable work, verify outcomes and judge whether any attention saving is real

records.disposition: run the consequence pilot before adding more Cognitive Kernel framework machinery
records.next_action: Execute matched real-task pairs under the frozen consequence protocol and report descriptive downstream outcomes.
